en.Feature: An input available when a prediction must be made.
en.Label: The target answer used to teach or evaluate a supervised model.
en.Baseline: A simple reference prediction rule for judging improvement.
en.Split: An assignment of examples to separate sets with different jobs.
en.Leakage: Information enters learning or selection even though it is unavailable in the intended prediction setting.
en.Group: Related records, such as all sessions from one device.
en.EDA: Inspection of data structure, ranges, and quality before modeling.
en.Imputation: Replacing unknown entries with a stated estimate or placeholder.
en.Median: The middle sorted value, or the mean of the two middle values for an even count.
en.Categorical feature: An input whose values identify groups or names.
en.One-hot encoding: Separate zero-or-one columns that identify one category.
en.Vocabulary: The saved list of known categories and their column order.
en.Slope: Prediction change for a one-unit input increase.
en.Intercept: The line’s prediction when the input is zero.
en.Residual: Prediction minus the observed target, using this chapter’s convention.
en.Gradient: Local slopes of the loss with respect to model parameters.
en.Learning rate: A multiplier that controls how strongly a gradient changes a parameter.
en.Standard deviation: A measure of spread; here it is the square root of the mean squared distance from the mean.
en.Positive class: The label we choose to count as one, not necessarily something good.
en.Sigmoid: A smooth function that maps any finite real score into a value between zero and one.
en.Threshold: The cutoff used to turn a probability estimate into a class choice.
en.Precision: Among predicted positives, the fraction that is truly positive.
en.Recall: Among actual positives, the fraction that is found.
en.Class imbalance: One class has many more examples than another.
en.Neighbour: A training example ranked close to the query under a chosen distance.
en.Euclidean distance: Straight-line distance from squared coordinate differences.
en.Hyperparameter: A setting chosen outside parameter fitting, such as the neighbour count k.
en.Token: One text unit produced by a chosen splitting rule.
en.Prior: The class probability before using the query’s words.
en.Smoothing: Adding small counts so known-vocabulary words never receive zero probability.
en.Leaf: A final tree region that supplies a prediction.
en.Gini impurity: A label-mixing score; for two classes it is 2p(1−p).
en.Ensemble: A prediction made by combining several models.
en.Residual learner: A small model trained to predict the remaining correction.
en.Stump: A decision tree with one split and two leaves.
en.Boosting round: One addition of a new correction model.
en.Centroid: The coordinate-wise mean of the points assigned to a group.
en.Projection: Coordinates obtained by measuring a point along selected directions.
en.Explained variance: The share of total spread retained by selected PCA directions.
en.User profile: A feature vector describing stated or inferred interests.
en.Cosine similarity: The dot product divided by both lengths, measuring directional alignment.
en.Candidate set: Items considered before ranking chooses their order.
en.Overfitting: Learning training-specific details that do not help new examples.
en.Regularization: A constraint or penalty that changes which fitted solutions are preferred.
en.Fold: One training/evaluation partition used during cross-validation.
en.Calibration: Agreement between predicted probabilities and observed frequencies over comparable cases.
en.Reliability bin: A group of examples with similar predicted probabilities.
en.Brier score: The mean squared difference between predicted probability and binary outcome.

zh.特征: 作出预测时已经可用的输入。
zh.标签: 用于训练或评估监督模型的目标答案。
zh.基线: 用于判断改进的简单参考预测规则。
zh.划分: 把样本分到承担不同任务的集合。
zh.数据泄漏: 学习或选择过程用到了预期预测场景中不可用的信息。
zh.分组: 相关记录的集合，例如同一设备的全部记录。
zh.探索性数据分析: 建模前检查数据结构、范围与质量。
zh.缺失值填补: 用明确的估计值或占位值替代未知项。
zh.中位数: 排序后的中间值；个数为偶数时取中间两值的平均。
zh.类别特征: 用取值标识组别或名称的输入。
zh.独热编码: 用多列零或一来标识所属类别。
zh.词表: 保存的已知类别列表及其列顺序。
zh.斜率: 输入增加一个单位时，预测值的变化。
zh.截距: 输入为零时直线的预测。
zh.残差: 按本章约定，为预测减去实测目标。
zh.梯度: 损失相对于模型参数的局部斜率。
zh.学习率: 控制梯度对参数改变幅度的乘数。
zh.标准差: 衡量离散程度；这里是与均值之差的平方均值再开平方。
zh.正类: 选择用一表示的标签，不一定意味着好事。
zh.Sigmoid 函数: 把任意有限实数分数平滑映射到零与一之间的函数。
zh.阈值: 把概率估计转为类别选择的界限。
zh.精确率: 预测为正的样本中，真实为正的比例。
zh.召回率: 真实为正的样本中，被找到的比例。
zh.类别不平衡: 一个类别的样本数量远多于另一个类别。
zh.邻居: 在所选距离下，靠近查询的训练样本。
zh.欧氏距离: 由坐标差的平方计算的直线距离。
zh.超参数: 在参数拟合之外选择的设置，例如邻居数 k。
zh.词元: 按选定切分规则产生的一个文本单位。
zh.先验: 使用查询词语之前的类别概率。
zh.平滑: 增加小计数，避免词表内的词得到零概率。
zh.叶子: 决策树中提供预测的最终区域。
zh.基尼不纯度: 衡量标签混杂的分数；二分类时为 2p(1−p)。
zh.集成: 组合多个模型得到预测。
zh.残差学习器: 学习预测剩余修正量的小模型。
zh.树桩: 只有一个分裂、两个叶子的决策树。
zh.提升轮次: 增加一个新修正模型的一次操作。
zh.质心: 一个分组内各坐标分别求平均得到的中心。
zh.投影: 沿选定方向测量一个点得到的坐标。
zh.解释方差: 选定 PCA 方向保留的总离散程度比例。
zh.用户画像: 描述主动表达或推断兴趣的特征向量。
zh.余弦相似度: 点积除以双方长度，用于衡量方向一致程度。
zh.候选集: 排序决定顺序之前考虑的物品集合。
zh.过拟合: 学到只适用于训练数据、不能帮助新样本的细节。
zh.正则化: 通过约束或惩罚改变对拟合解的偏好。
zh.折: 交叉验证中一次训练与评估的划分。
zh.校准: 相似案例中预测概率与观测频率的一致程度。
zh.可靠性分箱: 预测概率相近的一组样本。
zh.布里尔分数: 预测概率与二元结果之差的平方均值。
